meta.title: Growth services | Revora
meta.description: Audit, setup, training and ongoing support: Revora helps Algerian businesses build a growth system that lasts.

hero.title: *WE BUILD* / YOUR GROWTH SYSTEM.
hero.subtitle: A team with real marketing, sales and back-office experience. We connect customer acquisition, sales, operations and data, so your growth is visible and under control.

items.title: Growth audit
items.body: We map your acquisition, sales, operations and data, and find where growth is being lost.
outcomes: A map of your sales and operational processes
A diagnosis of leaks and wasted time
A detailed report and a priority action plan

items.title: Setup
items.body: We configure the Revora platform for your business: modules, data import, processes and roles.
outcomes: Modules enabled for your real needs
Import and checks of your existing data
Processes, roles and access rights set up for the whole team

items.title: Training
items.body: We train your teams (sales, back office, managers) in French or Arabic, on site in Algiers or remotely.
outcomes: Sessions tailored to each role and level
Hands-on practice on your own operations

items.title: Ongoing support
items.body: A long-term partner: we follow your results, update your dashboards and optimise your processes every month.
outcomes: Monthly review of your key indicators
A dedicated contact for your next steps
items.duration: Monthly, with no fixed minimum term

audience.title: Who is it for?
audience.body: Any Algerian business that wants to understand its growth better, whatever its size or sector.

process.title: How we *work*
process.body: We start by understanding how your business works, then we build the systems that improve its performance.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: We study your business, your customers, your teams and the tools you use today.

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.body: We find where growth is lost: untracked sales, stock, delays, scattered data.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: We put in place the right system: processes, platform, roles and dashboards.

steps.title: Grow
steps.body: We follow the results together and adjust the system over the months.

items.question: How much do the services cost?
items.answer: The price depends on your business, the size of your team and the scope you choose. We issue a tailored quote after the free audit.

items.question: How long does an engagement last?
items.answer: The durations shown on this page are indicative. An audit usually takes a few weeks, and setup depends on the number of modules and the volume of your data.

items.question: Do we need the Revora platform?
items.answer: No, the audit and support can be done without the platform. The Revora platform does make tracking your growth simpler and more visible day to day.

items.question: Is my data confidential?
items.answer: Yes. Your data remains yours, is never sold, and is only accessed by the team working on your file, under a confidentiality commitment.

items.question: Which languages do you work in?
items.answer: We work in French and Arabic, for training, documentation and exchanges with your teams.

cta.title: Where is your business growth *being lost*?
cta.body: Request a free audit. Together we will identify your first possible gains.
